findings.summary: In measureModelFootprint, model file sizes are queried sequentially. Consider using Promise.all for concurrent fs.stat calls to improve I/O performance.
The DiskPreflightError message interpolates float values like result.availableGb directly, which can print long unreadable decimals. Consider formatting with .toFixed(2).
findings.suggested_fix: const formattedMessage = message ?? `Insufficient disk space: ${result.availableGb.toFixed(2)} GB available, but ${result.minFreeDiskGb} GB required for reservation (model footprint: ${result.modelFootprintGb.toFixed(2)} GB)`;

findings.summary: If the specs array contains duplicate file specifications, measureModelFootprint will double-count their sizes. Consider tracking resolved paths in a Set to ensure unique files are counted once.
